manufacturer.name: LiftMaster
manufacturer.note: US gate and door operator brand of the Chamberlain Group. Its manuals live on support.chamberlaingroup.com as one article per document - HTML pages that link the PDFs rather than the PDFs themselves, so that target needs the harvester's follow step. Note the UL-suffixed model codes (LA400UL, CSW24UL) are separate listings from the bare ones and are recorded as separate models here, because whether they are the same operator under a certification suffix or a different build was not established.
